name: Furuya Tomonori
source:
Furuya is a timid and anti-social young man, with little social life outside of the internet. He has a god complex, and secretly wishes to change the world through the power of the Internet. 
[Spoiler]While he idolizes Kamui, this created a resentment towards him and Furuya wished to surpass him in scale. After the launch of Method Tank, Furuya changed his demeanor and appearance significantly, speaking in cryptic terms and fully embracing his status as a revolutionary.[/spoiler] 

[Edited from [url=https://killthepastwiki.com/Tomonori_Furuya]Wiki[/url]]
